_comment: Subset 4: 10 bugs across 5 files, planned by
tools/patcher/plan/subsets/subset-04.chunk-map.json.
Derived from run-config.example.json; only the inputs, the run id and the
loop knobs differ. Read that file for what every other knob means.
Validate before spending anything:
python3 tools/patcher/src/run_patcher.py --config tools/patcher/config/subset4.run-config.json --check
Paths may be absolute or relative to the repository root.

inputs._comment: 10 bugs, 7 playbook entries covering the 9 classes the bugs carry. Both are validated and scrubbed by blind_guard before any prompt is built.

_comment: work_tree is subset-scoped so a subset run and a full run can exist side by
side without one overwriting the other's tree.
node_modules is the shared install, symlinked in: it must not appear in the
diff or the tree hash.
Unchanged from the example. allowed_tools deliberately omits WebFetch and
WebSearch: upstream Juice Shop is the answer key, and one fetch of it would
end this run's validity.
effort and reasoning are stated here rather than inherited, even though these
are exactly the defaults: this subset's numbers get compared across runs, and a
config that leans on a default records what the default WAS, not what this run
ran at. If the default ever moves, this file still says high.
Read the example config for what they cost - roughly 2-3x the output (thinking)
tokens of low effort, on every invocation of every task.
execution 'waves' + task_granularity 'file' is the only combination that lets
task_concurrency exceed 1: waves guarantee no two agents hold the same file,
and that guarantee comes from grouping by file. Preflight refuses the pair
'sequential' + concurrency>1 rather than silently running one agent.
task_concurrency 2 is the PEAK this subset needs, not a general setting: the
only phase with two independent chunks is phase 1 (C09, C11). Phases 0 and 2
hold a single chunk each and run one agent regardless.
granularity 'file' batches the bugs that share a file into one task, which is
what makes the critical path 4 tasks rather than 9 bug-sized ones.
gate_concurrency null means the post-wave gate follows task_concurrency. Left
null deliberately: the widest wave here is 2 units, so there is no barrier
worth widening and no reason to risk two concurrent test runs contending.
Unchanged from the example. final_full_suite runs once, after the last wave;
run_patcher skips it when waves remain, so a checkpointed subset run does not
publish a partial tree as a finished one.

commands._comment: Unchanged from the example. The runner executes these itself; the agent's claim that it ran them is an attestation, never a gate.

outputs._comment: Outside the repository: transcripts and per-task records pair a bug id with a file and a line, which the publishing rule does not allow in a committed artefact.

sandbox._comment: Appended to the built-in deny sets in hooks/sandbox_guard.py. Add here; do not weaken there.
